topic: start page numbering on page 2 instead of page 1 in Word
core_question: How do I make my Word document's page numbers begin on the second page?
answer_summary: Enable Header & Footer 'Different First Page,' then in Page Number Format set 'Start at' 0 (or 1) so numbering effectively begins as page 2.
